summary: All demonstrated R1/R2 metric/source defects are closed for exact R3 plan/source. Incremental CPU tests reject corrupted score/coverage evidence and accept the full registered dev-freeze-three-test protocol.
scope: CPU-only source/GT/metric/result-admission protocol. Artificial private fixtures only; no neural, torch model import, GPU, SSH or original E0 progress query.

ground_truth_provenance.details: Original dataset/toolkit GT provenance established in R1 and byte-rechecked in R2. R3 uses identical five registered manifest bytes; actual full three-test scorer execution rechecks every saved GT array against those manifests and current provided-toolkit records. RGBT210/234 annotation-file hashes are also checked by the scorer. No GT is derived from predictions.

metric_protocol.details: Toolkit7 and old LasHeR scorer unchanged; groundtruth/load_manifest/evaluation_command ASTs unchanged. Seven independent arithmetic goldens retained. Three full-test aggregate outputs equal R2 for exactly the same artificial prediction arrays.

prediction_normalization.details: No prediction-statistic score denominator. Original per-frame modality maximum, fixed frame denominators, sequence macro average, float32 prediction rounding and LasHeR GT special handling are unchanged.

full_registered_coverage_and_identity.details: Full registered manifest SHA/counts, model variant/path, source44, shared checkpoint/cost/candidate/capacity, canonical native argv and exact per-shard manifest slices are enforced. The prior swapped-shard counterexample now rejects.

frozen_dev_result_origin.details: Actual freezer CLI recomputes three complete 97-sequence/54,646-frame score reports using the source-bound CPU scorer and requires full parsed-JSON equality. It validates exact complete raw run artifacts, native/config/complete metadata, sequences, timing and common capacity before creating the selection. Scalar-score and per-sequence-score modifications reject without creating a frozen file.

test_freeze_identity.details: Selection file is bound by the explicit test CLI SHA and native canonical command. Same checkpoint and frozen cost/candidate configuration is used for all three registered benchmarks in this protocol; dataset-specific variants require a separately registered future protocol.

claim_scope.details: This is SOURCE_PASS for CPU metric/source protocol only, same-family/provisional with routing UNATTESTED. All executed prediction/timing/native records are private artificial protocol fixtures. No actual neural evaluation, full-C completion, model capacity, FPS/latency, new baseline, benchmark performance or target attainment is established.

R3_added_scorer_statements.source: assert all((config['sequences'] == [row['name'] for row in manifest['sequences'][config['shard']::config['shards']]] for config in configs))

incremental_reuse_verification.scope: R1 four scorer fixes, R2 argv/metadata rejections and seven unchanged metric goldens reused. Only added/changed R3 freeze/shard paths re-executed.

limits: SOURCE_PASS does not constitute NN execution admission by itself; the separate NN SOURCE gate, real inference smoke, full-C/checkpoint provenance and actual frozen full benchmark evaluations remain required.

The copied fixture uses real registered GT/manifests, manually defined predictions, fabricated timing/native metadata and a synthetic checkpoint hash. It tests protocol acceptance and rejection, never neural performance.
The provided toolkit version, including old LasHeR special GT behavior and RGBT234 annotation-version choice, remains the governing metric protocol.
Interior image pixels were not decoded by this review. Existing preparation establishes counts and first/last image-pair readiness only.
